description: Closed relation vocabulary for KO schema v1. A relation is legal only if (form of subject, verb, form of object) matches a row here. Edges are stored once on the subject; the compiler materialises the inverse edge deterministically so a consumer can walk either direction. 'cardinality' constrains how many objects a subject may point at through the verb.
